flag: n=3 female test speakers — selectivity is within-sample, not a population claim
framing_note: aligned cosine proves stable-to-RETRAINING only; same 3 female speakers every seed, so this does NOT prove stable-across-female-samples (that confound is unresolved and carries to the F0 analysis)
basis_caveat: unit indices and raw (unaligned) direction vectors are not comparable across architectures; all comparisons here are within-arch, across-seed
gru_note: crnn_gru is the PRE-REGISTERED negative control: near-chance global sex-decodability means it should show an UNSTABLE direction too, not just unstable units.
diagnostic_finding: pure-random-vector aligned cosine ~=0 (rotation is not degenerate), but group-mean-difference vectors from ANY 3-vs-9 re-split of the 12 fixed SI test speakers -- real sex split or arbitrary -- show high (0.7-0.96) cross-seed aligned cosine. Localizes the high permutation floor to the ESTIMATOR (small-sample group contrast on an extremely low-rank representation, ~94% variance in top 10 PCs), not to a broken alignment. See per-arch rotation_sanity_mean/top10_pc_variance_fraction and metric_caveat below.

rows.metric_caveat: permutation null itself is high (0.7-0.9) for ANY 3-vs-9 re-split of these 12 speakers -- extreme representation low-rank (see top10_pc_variance_fraction) means the raw mean-diff CAV cosine cannot cleanly separate a sex-specific direction from a generic reproducible individual-grouping contrast at n=12; rotation itself is clean (random-vector sanity check ~0, see rotation_sanity_mean)
